assumptions: MySQLdb parameter binding and MySQL identifier grammar; trusted connection and database selection.
Qualification covers the named SELECT flow, not every database operation.
cases.fixed_control: The value is passed as the second execute argument; every interpolated identifier is backtick-delimited after doubling embedded backticks in _escape_id.
cases.mechanism: A WebDAV primary-key value and table identifier are concatenated into a MySQL SELECT in _exists_record_by_primary_key.

assumptions: POSIX destination semantics; trusted destination root without hostile links or concurrent filesystem mutation.
Windows drive-relative names and race resistance are not qualified.
cases.fixed_control: _parse_cd_args rejects slash, backslash and the exact parent component before returning the peer filename to _recv_files.
cases.mechanism: An SCP peer's C/D request filename reaches posixpath.join and _recv_file/_recv_dir filesystem operations.

assumptions: Primitive string user_id; POSIX paths and trusted base directory without hostile links or concurrent mutation.
This does not certify Windows drive-relative paths, user-id normalization consistency, or all later memory operations.
cases.fixed_control: The constructor calls _sanitise_user_id before joining; it raises for either separator or a '..' substring. The original string is still joined, but any traversal string in the qualified POSIX model has already raised.
cases.mechanism: FileMemory joins a supplied user_id to the configured memory base and creates the resulting directories.

assumptions: Trusted corpus root; input is an ordinary filesystem path string, not an overridden object.
The disclosure is limited to the filename suffix and parseable frequency data described by the source.
Qualification covers path containment in a stable filesystem; platform-specific hardlink/descriptor race protection is not claimed.
cases.fixed_control: The reader now calls pathsec.open with required_root=self.root. The bound helper resolves root and target and rejects targets outside that root; ENFORCE is True at the pinned revision.
cases.mechanism: Crubadan table column zero supplies a code joined to the corpus root and read as a *-3grams.txt file.

assumptions: Named res/ or /res/ manifest branch, trusted resource root and stable filesystem.
Fallback folder search, unrelated archive extraction, download authentication and concurrent link swaps are outside this qualification.
cases.fixed_control: The selected res/ branch rejects traversal input and checks realpath containment with a separator boundary before either returned candidate. The helper body is bound in security.py; its previous location in utils.py is also retained.
cases.mechanism: A manifest android:icon path is resolved by find_icon_path_zip and its returned file is copied into the download directory.

assumptions: Trusted save directory and stable filesystem; no concurrent symlink replacement.
The named non-default template branch is the control; unrelated save/push behavior is excluded.
cases.fixed_control: Both writes compare the resolved output parent to the resolved chat-template directory and raise on a mismatch before open.
cases.mechanism: Non-default chat-template dictionary keys become .jinja output paths in processor/tokenizer save operations.

assumptions: h5py's getlink/getclass semantics and ordinary HDF5 objects.
KerasFileEditor link disclosure only; tensor allocation limits and every load_weights path are not certified.
HDF5 dereference is a less conventional file-read primitive; lack of a recognized builtin sink must remain a miss.
cases.commit_selection: Advisory reference index 1 includes the file-editor link checks and virtual-dataset rejection; reference index 0 is retained as acquisition evidence only.
cases.fixed_control: Use the later complete advisory-linked patch: inspect link type before dereference, reject ExternalLink/SoftLink, use the bound safe_get_h5_group helper for vars, and reject external/virtual datasets before value[()].
cases.mechanism: KerasFileEditor dereferences attacker-controlled HDF5 links while extracting groups and datasets.

assumptions: The authorized working directory is trusted; stable filesystem.
Only static source text is acquired/analyzed: no bridge, MCP server, CLI or model is called.
The separate at-command mode is outside the named advisory mechanism.
cases.fixed_control: _resolve_path resolves root and candidate, uses relative_to, and _prepare_inline_payload skips a None result before reading.
cases.mechanism: Inline file attachments pass caller-supplied paths to _read_file_for_inline.

assumptions: Trusted FILE_LOADER_ROOT_PATH and filesystem without hostile symlinks or concurrent mutation.
This is a lexical traversal/decoding control, not a symlink containment guarantee.
cases.fixed_control: Decode before abspath and commonpath containment; the literal-filename fallback receives the same boundary check. No decoding follows either accepted candidate.
cases.mechanism: The file loader validates an encoded path then decodes it before reading, also allowing a sibling directory through a raw string prefix.

assumptions: Operator-controlled environment and CWD, ordinary strings and a stable filesystem.
Only output-path confinement is qualified; URL/network behavior and other modules are excluded.
cases.fixed_control: The output now passes the bound validate_path_with_env_config/validate_path_safe helper before mkdir/open. Its base comes from FLYTO_SANDBOX_DIR or CWD, and canonical containment includes a separator boundary.
cases.mechanism: image_download previously checked a supplied output path against an equally caller-controlled output_dir, then wrote the downloaded bytes.

assumptions: Trusted download directory, OS basename semantics, no later decoding and no hostile filesystem links.
Qualified download flow only; no packages are installed or executed.
cases.fixed_control: Link.filename stops the second URL decoding and reduces to an OS basename. _get_http_response_filename applies as_path_component before the guarded join/open, rejecting empty/dot/parent results.
cases.mechanism: A package URL/response filename can be decoded into a path component that resets or escapes the download directory.

assumptions: TarFile calls the guarded _extract_member for members; trusted root and no concurrent local filesystem mutation.

The old call and relocated guarded sink require a broad single scoring interval in the existing runner. Range-localized warnings are a proxy, not a claim that every warning in this interval is the advisory.
cases.fixed_control: safe_tar_extractall wraps each _extract_member operation: realpath/commonpath containment, accepted entry kinds, link-destination containment and mode sanitization precede the original member extraction.
cases.mechanism: A supplied session tar archive reaches extractall under the local download directory.

assumptions: allow_remote_refs is explicitly False, as in the advisory; the default warning mode is not a negative control.
Trusted base path/cache state, normal Path semantics, stable filesystem.
Canonical repository rename is verified by the commit API response; both old and new identities are screened.
cases.fixed_control: The bound _resolve_local_ref_path resolves both paths and raises outside the base in the False configuration; both local read routes use it before load_data_from_path. The file:// dispatch also honors the disabled external-reference option.
cases.mechanism: JSON-Schema file:// or relative references can read outside the input base despite allow_remote_refs=False.

assumptions: The named repeated-percent-decoding mechanism and trusted configured base URL/policy identifier.
No claim about all URL parser differences, authentication, SSRF, or websocket behavior.
This is URL path traversal; a detector limited to filesystem sinks can legitimately miss it.
cases.fixed_control: _sanitize_proxy_path now rejects any value still changed by unquote after the cap, then normalizes/rejects parent references before proxy_terminal constructs the upstream URL.
cases.mechanism: A terminal proxy path can remain encoded after eight decoding rounds and acquire traversal syntax downstream.

assumptions: Trusted base/root configuration; POSIX stable filesystem without hostile symlinks.
The lexical prefix boundary is qualified; symlink confinement and restrict_path=False are not.
cases.fixed_control: With restrict_path=True (the pinned default), the decoded normalized absolute filename must begin with the absolute root plus a path separator before open. The root-ending-separator case preserves that boundary.
cases.mechanism: A Markdown image src is converted to a local path and read into a base64 data URL outside the intended root.

assumptions: Fresh private temporary directory, ordinary strings, no hostile links or concurrent local mutation.
Only staging writes are qualified; no sandbox, container, model or remote execution is started.
cases.fixed_control: Archive names are POSIX-normalized and reject absolute/parent escapes. The actual staging writer independently checks the absolute joined path against the fresh temporary-directory prefix plus os.sep before mkdir/open.
cases.mechanism: Skill archive entry names become paths in a local staging directory and are written before sandbox transfer.

assumptions: Trusted source document location, POSIX path semantics and stable filesystem.
HTML rendering and recursion exhaustion beyond the named path-read mechanism are not certified.
cases.fixed_control: Both paths are resolved using realpath; absolute titles or a commonpath outside the source directory return an error before open. Recursive include state carries the current file and detects cycles.
cases.mechanism: An include directive joins an arbitrary relative title to the source document directory and reads it.

assumptions: Primitive route strings, trusted static roots/plugins and stable filesystem.
Only path containment is qualified; filename compatibility and authentication policy are separate.
cases.fixed_control: Both route components are reduced to ASCII letters/digits/underscore, and an empty result aborts before directory construction.
cases.mechanism: The static-content route allowed '..' as a group, changing the directory supplied to send_from_directory.

assumptions: Prompt file location and any additional allowed roots are caller-authorized; stable filesystem.
Environment-variable expansion and model behavior are excluded.
cases.fixed_control: _resolve_file_reference resolves the candidate and requires membership in the prompt directory or an explicitly trusted allowed_file_roots entry. The returned resolved path is passed to the reader.
cases.mechanism: ${file:...} prompt references resolve to arbitrary local files and are opened by _load_file_content.

assumptions: Trusted option identifier from the table-option API; Snowflake's documented ordinary string-literal grammar.
Only LiteralOption string values are qualified. Other SQL/connection vulnerabilities in the same advisory require other commits.
Literal construction without a visible execute call remains in scope and must not be dropped if the detector misses it.
cases.commit_selection: Advisory reference index 1 is the exact parent/fix pair for LiteralOption; the separate connection and other identifier patches are not conflated.
cases.fixed_control: The string branch delegates through TableOption to escape_string_literal_interior, which doubles both single quotes and backslashes before insertion. Integer values use the integer template.
cases.mechanism: LiteralOption inserts a string value directly inside a single-quoted Snowflake DDL literal.
cases.taxonomy_note: The aggregate official advisory is tagged CWE-73 only. Preserve that tag in the manifest; the SQL detector category is a source-review mapping for the explicitly described LiteralOption SQL mechanism, not a claim that GitHub assigned CWE-89.

assumptions: Trusted CWD, ordinary paths, stable filesystem and use through the validated public upload method.
The private direct reader is not claimed to be an independent public sandbox. Nothing is uploaded or sent during qualification.
cases.fixed_control: upload_attachment now replaces the path with the result of validate_safe_path before forwarding. The bound io.py helper resolves root and target and rejects a non-relative target.
cases.mechanism: Public upload_attachment accepts a local path and forwards it to _upload_attachment_direct's open call.

assumptions: Trusted output directory, primitive decoded commit message and stable filesystem without hostile links.
The sanitizer is an analysis target; the unchanged actual write caller is pinned as qualification-only context because the unchanged v1 pair runner requires different blobs for each scored file.
cases.fixed_control: get_summary now keeps only ASCII alphanumerics, dot and underscore with other characters replaced by hyphens, collapses repeated dots and removes trailing dot/hyphen. The caller adds a numeric prefix and .patch suffix before joining/opening.
cases.mechanism: A commit subject reaches porcelain.format_patch's generated output filename through get_summary.

assumptions: Trusted canonical configured roots, POSIX filesystem without hostile links or concurrent mutation.
Conversion options disabled for the named direct FileResponse flow; authentication and conversion subprocesses are not qualified.
Root '/' and trailing separators can cause false rejections; this is not a compatibility certification.
cases.fixed_control: Every selected normalized join requires the configured root plus os.sep before FileResponse, excluding equal-prefix siblings.
cases.mechanism: Music/picture route paths exploit a raw prefix check to address a sibling directory whose name starts with the configured root.

assumptions: Trusted workspace root and stable filesystem; no concurrent link swaps.
Path output only; Jinja template execution/security is not qualified and no template is executed.
cases.commit_selection: Reference index 0 changes recursive rendering only; index 1 contains the path guard and is used for this named mechanism.
cases.fixed_control: Use the advisory's path-fixing reference: validate_local_path resolves output/root and requires relative_to(root) before directory creation or file open. The helper existed in the parent and is bound unchanged.
cases.mechanism: Jinja output names/control paths become output files and directories outside the trestle workspace.

source_policy: Original blobs remain in external object-only Git caches; this file pins both analysis inputs and qualification-only dependency context. Only cases.json targets are materialized for the detector.
